name: project-coding-profiles
description: Per-project coding profiles: declare a single project's encoding policy (GBK/UTF-8), overall coding mode, and interface scaffolding, enforced via skills + hooks scoped to that project. Complements team-standards (the team-wide standard). First profile: Yoooni (src=GBK / WebRoot=UTF-8 mixed encoding).

interface.shortDescription: Per-project encoding & coding conventions, enforced by skill + hook.
interface.longDescription: Carries a coding profile per project. The first capability is an encoding guard: it stops AI editors from corrupting legacy GBK files by re-saving them as UTF-8. Works across Claude Code, Codex (PreToolUse hook) and Cursor (rule guidance).
